testcase.name: Scenario: Repeat the last navigation wheel command: tmp/obk-wheel-3945-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:171:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Repeat the last navigation wheel command ✔ Given a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full navigation wheel was the last command used ✔ And the wheel is closed ✔ When the user right-clicks the model viewport ✔ Then the context menu offers to repeat the navigation wheel command ✔ When the user chooses the repeat navigation wheel command ✔ Then the full navigation wheel appears over the model ✔ And the same part remains active ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
